content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: in-service candidates applying for the post on deployment shall have their pay protected. The notice prints no pay amount. Teaching Honorarium: in the case of Assistant Professor, candidates may receive a Teaching Honorarium decided by the Health & Family Welfare Department. Tenure: Assistant Professor shall have a tenure of five years from the date of assumption of charge or until promotion to Associate Professor, subject to adherence to the prescribed norms and fulfilment of the criteria set by the National Medical Commission (NMC) from time to time. Probation: not applicable. Tenure for Senior Resident and Tutor/Demonstrator: not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DME Meghalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 13 vacancies at Shillong Medical College: 1 Assistant Professor, 9 Senior Resident and 3 Tutor/Demonstrator.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach by post or email no later than 5:00 PM on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Eligible in-service Doctors of the Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Meghalaya can apply. For Assistant Professor, the candidate must be a serving medical officer/Specialist holding a substantive position at the time of application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Senior Resident and Tutor/Demonstrator?
faq.answer: Senior Resident requires a Medical Postgraduate degree (MD/MS/DNB) to the concerned subject. Tutor/Demonstrator requires an MBBS Degree.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The candidate needs an MD/MS/DNB/DM/M.Ch or equivalent degree in the concerned discipline, permanent registration with a Central or Meghalaya State Medical Council, and one year as Senior Resident after MD/MS. DM/M.Ch/DNB holders need no additional teaching experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: There is no upper age criterion for Assistant Professor. Senior Resident and Tutor/Demonstrator candidates must be below 45 years of age at the time of appointment.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the Declaration Form (Annexure-I), the Proforma (Annexure-II) and supporting documents by post to the DME office in Shillong or by email to [email protected] by 5:00 PM on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What should the envelope or email subject line say?
faq.answer: It should read: "Application for the Position of Assistant Professor, Senior Resident, Tutor/Demonstrator at Shillong Medical College, Shillong".

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates appear for a walk-in interview before a panel of subject experts, with document verification, at the DME office in Shillong.

faq.question: Q10. What is the tenure of the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor has a tenure of five years from the date of assumption of charge or until promotion to Associate Professor, subject to NMC norms. Probation is not applicable.
